convert_pdb_input_to_atom_input: convert a PDBInput object with mmCIF filepath to a MoleculeInput then AtomInput
build_batched_atom_input_from_list: build a BatchedAtomInput by collating a list of AtomInput objects with padding and windowing
create_alphafold3_input_from_sequences: create an Alphafold3Input from protein, DNA, RNA sequences and ligand SMILES strings
load_msa_features_from_directory: load multiple sequence alignment features from an MSA directory for each chain of a biomolecule
sample_pdb_structures_from_dataset: sample PDB mmCIF structures from a PDBDataset with optional weighted sampling and cropping
